Jubilee.reason: JUBILEE LINE: From 0430 Saturday 3 until 0130 Sunday 4 October, no service between Green Park and Canary Wharf. If travelling between Central London and North Greenwich, please travel via Stratford.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Severe delays between Rickmansworth and Amersham/Chesham due to an earlier trespasser on the track at Chalfont & Latimer. London Buses are accepting valid tickets via any reasonable route. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Northern.reason: Northern Line: Minor delays due to an earlier points failure at Camden Town. All northbound Charing Cross branch trains will go to High Barnet / Mill Hill East and all northbound trains on the Bank branch will travel to Edgware. If you're travelling beyond Camden Town, please take the first train and change there.

Tram.reason: London Trams: Saturday 3 until Wednesday 7 October, no eastbound service Wandle Park - Centrale and westbound service Church Street - Wandle Park. Also no service between Arena and Elmers End on Sunday 4 October

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Minor delays due to a track fault at Brixton

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.

Windrush.reason: Windrush Line: Minor delays between Surrey Quays and Clapham Junction while we fix a faulty train at Clapham Junction. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
